defect_register.finding: Frozen batter archives serialized only an opposing-pitcher display name, so probability consumption could not prove which MLB pitcher identity entered the feature bundle.
defect_register.root_cause: PropProjection dropped HitterGameContext.opposing_pitcher_id during construction and JSON serialization.
defect_register.affected_scope: Every archived batter probability using pitcher context, including Hits, HR, and derived Total Bases.
defect_register.repair: Carry the exact MLB opposing_pitcher_id from the consumed feature bundle through PropProjection and archive serialization.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: Frozen comparator consumption requires equality with the immutable T-4 probable-starter receipt; missing or conflicting identity is unassessable.

defect_register.finding: The supported production slate did not archive Total Bases, and adding it directly would violate the existing candidate-only gate and break automation.
defect_register.root_cause: Total Bases is intentionally excluded from run_slate and PropEngine rejects it without explicit candidate provenance.
defect_register.affected_scope: Required frozen-simulator comparator for Total Bases.
defect_register.repair: Preserve run_slate unchanged and add a separate hash-bound Total Bases runner using an outcome-blind structural candidate config.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: The comparator requires two separate archives with exact config/model/run-option identities; neither can impersonate the other.

defect_register.finding: The live provider client exposed only DraftKings batter_hits.
defect_register.root_cause: The original operational-smoke lane was intentionally market-specific.
defect_register.affected_scope: Fresh market comparators for HR and Total Bases.
defect_register.repair: Add a separate inert client method requesting batter_hits, batter_home_runs, and batter_total_bases in one event request; the existing Hits method and running collectors remain unchanged.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: The new resolver keeps markets separate and requires the locked key for each output.

defect_register.finding: A one-sided, cross-book, late, duplicated, or timestamp-inconsistent quote could be mistaken for a valid market-implied probability.
defect_register.root_cause: No shared three-market probability-consumption boundary existed.
defect_register.affected_scope: Hits, HR, and Total Bases market comparison.
defect_register.repair: Require same event/book/market/player/line, unique Over and Under SIDs, one shared market timestamp, receipt and timestamp no later than T-4, and exact two-sided de-vigging.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: Invalid evidence receives an explicit terminal disposition and no probability; unmatched provider players remain in the candidate funnel.

defect_register.finding: Comparator records needed crash-safe immutable publication.
defect_register.root_cause: The new normalized records had no write-once persistence boundary.
defect_register.repair: Canonical hash envelope plus atomic hard-link publication; exact retry verifies and conflicting retry cannot overwrite.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: May, non-research, betting-authorized, malformed, and conflicting records are rejected before publication.

single_highest_value_next_action: Land an exact reviewed release, integrate it as a new non-overlapping AWS comparator service, and complete one future T-4 non-economic smoke before opening a fresh prospective evidence era; do not alter or backfill the existing pitcher or shared-PA collectors.
